## Description

Integrates recurrent neural networks with multivariate Hawkes point processes to forecast sudden volatility jumps and jump clustering intervals induced by bursty order arrival cascades.

## Where it may fit

Options pricing during earnings releases, macroeconomic news release shocks, volatility spike prediction.

## Vehicles

Volatility Arbitrage Funds, Options Market Making Desks.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, option implied volatility ticks, trade timestamps.

## Caveats

Recurrent Hawkes intensity models require high-performance C++/GPU execution engines.
